hero.description: Building modern digital products - from websites to mobile apps.
about.title: Turning ideas into clear digital products.
about.paragraph1: I am a full-stack developer focused on building clean, useful and scalable digital products. My work sits between interface, backend, data and product thinking.
about.paragraph2: I like quiet interfaces, clear architecture and experiences that make complex workflows feel direct. The goal is always the same: ship software that looks sharp and works reliably.

testimonials.title: /Trusted by builders.
testimonials.intro: Feedback from people who value precise interfaces, reliable delivery and product-minded engineering.
testimonials.ana.text: Marcio translated a messy product idea into an elegant interface and a reliable backend. The final experience felt much more mature than our first brief.
testimonials.michael.text: He thinks beyond screens. The architecture, performance decisions and interaction details were all handled with the discipline I expect from a senior product team.
testimonials.beatriz.text: Fast communication, polished execution and a very clear process from discovery to launch.
testimonials.lucas.text: The project needed design sensitivity and technical depth. Marcio delivered both, with clean components and animations that felt premium without getting in the way.
testimonials.sofia.text: Working with him felt calm and structured. He made strong product decisions and kept the build moving.
testimonials.daniel.text: Beautiful UI, thoughtful code and a launch that did not create surprises.
testimonials.emma.text: He brought the same care to the small states as he did to the hero moments. That consistency made the product feel expensive.
testimonials.rafael.text: The final site was fast, responsive and easy for the team to maintain.
testimonials.claire.text: Marcio has a rare balance of visual taste and implementation rigor. Every iteration made the product clearer, calmer and more useful.
